name: salesforce
description: Connect Salesforce Service Cloud and Sales Cloud for customer support and CRM workflows

envVars.name: SALESFORCE_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Optional: consumer key of your own Salesforce OAuth app. Hosted Veryfront uses the installed Veryfront package instead.

envVars.name: SALESFORCE_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Optional: consumer secret of your own Salesforce OAuth app

envVars.name: SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_ID
envVars.description: Service account: consumer key of an External Client App that uses the Client Credentials Flow. Set it together with the secret and login URL.

envVars.name: SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_SECRET
envVars.description: Service account: consumer secret of the Client Credentials Flow app

envVars.name: SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_LOGIN_URL
envVars.description: Service account: the org's My Domain origin, for example https://acme.my.salesforce.com. Generic login hosts are rejected.

q.description: SOQL Contact query. Include Account fields when the agent needs customer context.
q.default: SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, Title, AccountId, Account.Name, Account.Type, Account.Industry FROM Contact ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT Id, Name, Type, Industry, Phone, Website, OwnerId, LastModifiedDate FROM Account ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT 50
SELECT Id, FirstName, LastName, Email, Phone, Title, AccountId, Account.Name FROM Contact ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT 50

q.description: SOQL Case query. Filter by ContactId, AccountId, Status, OwnerId, Priority, or CreatedDate as needed.
q.default: SELECT Id, CaseNumber, Subject, Status, Priority, Origin, ContactId, AccountId, OwnerId, CreatedDate, LastModifiedDate FROM Case ORDER BY LastModifiedDate DESC LIMIT 50

q.description: SOQL CaseComment query. Add WHERE ParentId = '<caseId>' to inspect one case.
q.default: SELECT Id, ParentId, CommentBody, CreatedDate, CreatedById, IsPublished FROM CaseComment ORDER BY CreatedDate DESC LIMIT 50

q.description: SOQL KnowledgeArticleVersion query. Filter by Title, Summary, DataCategory, or language when needed.
q.default: SELECT Id, KnowledgeArticleId, Title, Summary, UrlName, Language, LastPublishedDate FROM KnowledgeArticleVersion WHERE PublishStatus = 'Online' ORDER BY LastPublishedDate DESC LIMIT 25
SELECT Id, Name, StageName, Amount, CloseDate, AccountId, OwnerId, LastModifiedDate FROM Opportunity ORDER BY CloseDate DESC LIMIT 50

IsPublished.description: Whether the comment is visible externally

sobjectType.description: Salesforce object API name, for example Case, Account, Contact, Opportunity, or a custom object

q.description: Read-only SOQL query, for example SELECT Id, Subject FROM Case LIMIT 10

setupGuide.title: Salesforce setup

steps.title: Choose how Veryfront reaches Salesforce
steps.description: Per-user OAuth acts as each connected Salesforce user; hosted Veryfront provides the OAuth app through the Veryfront Salesforce Integration package, so no environment variables are needed. A service account runs scheduled or project-owned automation as a dedicated integration user without browser consent.

steps.title: Install the Veryfront package
steps.description: As a Salesforce administrator, install the Veryfront Salesforce Integration beta package in each org users connect, choosing Install for Admins Only. Salesforce rejects authorization from an org without it. Try a sandbox or test org first.

steps.title: Enable the Veryfront app
steps.description: In Setup, open External Client App Manager, select Veryfront and confirm it is Packaged (Installed) and Enabled. Under Policies, restrict the permitted users to the profiles or permission sets that should connect.

steps.title: Connect a Salesforce user
steps.description: In Veryfront, start the Salesforce connection from the project's integrations, sign in to the org where the package is installed and approve consent. No integration policy is needed before the first call. Only when you use your own OAuth app instead of the package, register https://api.veryfront.com/oauth/callback/salesforce as its callback URL and set SALESFORCE_CLIENT_ID and SALESFORCE_CLIENT_SECRET.

steps.title: Or configure a service account
steps.description: Create a dedicated integration user with the least object, field and API permissions the tools need, and an External Client App with the Client Credentials Flow, the api scope and that user as Run As user. Set SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_ID, SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_SECRET and SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_LOGIN_URL (the org's My Domain origin). All three are required in this mode; if one is missing, runs fail closed instead of falling back to a user connection.

steps.title: Verify access
steps.description: Run Find Customer (read-only). With its default query it returns the most recently changed contacts and their accounts from the target org without changing them. For a service account, confirm the Salesforce audit trail attributes the request to the integration user.

notes: The user connection requests api, refresh_token and offline_access.

Non-interactive runs can use a service account instead of a user connection: set SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_ID, SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_CLIENT_SECRET and SALESFORCE_SERVICE_ACCOUNT_LOGIN_URL (the My Domain origin) from an External Client App that uses the Client Credentials Flow with a dedicated Run As user. All three are required; see https://veryfront.com/docs/code/guides/integrations/salesforce#use-a-service-account
Tools that create, update or delete records are marked as writes and need write authority; the other tools are read-only.
